value.task: Diagnose one failed PtcRunner run using only immutable evidence. Discover the run and determine whether evidence proves one faulty component. A code change requires externally expected behavior and evidence that distinguishes the faulty implementation from its callers, dependencies, contracts, and inputs. Do not guess across incomplete or ambiguous evidence. A final propose-change report has exactly the flat keys decision, run_id, cause, target_environment, target_mission, component_id, function_id, base_source_hash, candidate_source, invariant, evidence, validation_plan. evidence is an array of strings and validation_plan is an array of objects with string property and test. candidate_source is the complete replacement component and preserves unrelated exports. Otherwise finish with insufficient-evidence containing exactly decision, run_id, cause, and missing_evidence, where missing_evidence is an array of strings.
